name: Naixu Guo
biography: I completed my PhD at the Centre for Quantum Technologies, National University of Singapore, supervised by Patrick Rebentrost. I will soon join Alan Aspuru-Guzik at the University of Toronto as a postdoctoral researcher.
institution: Centre for Quantum Technologies, National University of Singapore
identity: Quantum computing and agents for science.

hero.title: Quantum Computing and Agents for Science
hero.intro: My research spans quantum computing and agents for science. I work on quantum algorithms and learning, and on ways to build and evaluate agents that carry out scientific research.
hero.questionLead: Beyond the immediate technical problems, I keep one wider question in view.
hero.question: If intelligence becomes as cheap and available as water and electricity, where does science go?
hero.questionZh: 倘若智能如水电一样便宜、易得，科学将何去何从？
